Title: [LSJ] Blocking, Illusions of the Kindred, Deception, and Jason

Messages.Author: vermillian
Messages.Body:
1.) Anneke, with serpentis, is blocking. Petru plays Shimulo
Deception, anneke plays extortion. Petru plays Illusions of the
Kindred, and then Extortion. The New vampire is another Petru. When
combat from this Petru ends, Petru wishes to play Extortion.

What's wrong with the above? Why? Especially that last bit. "...this
vampire [petru: we can't tell the difference between this petru and
the previous one, can we?] has succesfully blocked." so why are you
going to say "no"?

2.) Jason is acting. He's blocked by Anneke. Same thing as above
happens. Who burns blood? Anneke, Petru number one, or Petru number
two (obviously the latter is moot if that second Petru isn't
considered blocking).

3.) That first bits moot because the Illusionary Petru gets removed
from the game before he could play a card that says "play after
combat, if any", isn't it? Sorry...

4.) Is an IotK vampire from a succesful blocking vampire considered
blocking?

~SV

Messages.Author: reyda
Messages.Body:
vermillian wrote:
> 1.) Anneke, with serpentis, is blocking. Petru plays Shimulo
> Deception, anneke plays extortion. Petru plays Illusions of the
> Kindred, and then Extortion. The New vampire is another Petru. When
> combat from this Petru ends, Petru wishes to play Extortion.

there is a problem in your demonstration.

Extortion has to be played AFTER combat,if any.
So here is what happens : Anneke succefully blocks. Petru plays Shilmulo
Deception. Petru enters combat. Now you want to play Illusion of the
kindred, fine. When the illusionary combat finishes, the original Petru TM
can play extortion.

-The illusion cannot play extortion,since he is not ready after the combat,
and is not the blocking vampire. (this is why "i say no" : a vampire who's
not in the game anymore *and* doesnt fulfill the condition on a card can't
play a card.)
-Anneke is no longer the blocking vampire, so she cannot play extortion
either.

> 2.) Jason is acting. He's blocked by Anneke. Same thing as above
> happens. Who burns blood? Anneke, Petru number one, or Petru number
> two (obviously the latter is moot if that second Petru isn't
> considered blocking).

Following the same logic, it's Petru number one, since he's the one who
actually blocked the action.

> 3.) That first bits moot because the Illusionary Petru gets removed
> from the game before he could play a card that says "play after
> combat, if any", isn't it? Sorry...

he is removed from the game at the end of any round of combat where no press
played during the press step, or at the end of the round of a combat
interrupted in any manner : strike: combat ends, rotschreck, Illusion of the
kindred, one of the combattant goes to torpor... So he's obviously not here
after the combat.

> 4.) Is an IotK vampire from a succesful blocking vampire considered
> blocking?

nope.
and It's an illusion after all ;)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
vermillian wrote:
> 1.) Anneke, with serpentis, is blocking. Petru plays Shimulo
> Deception, anneke plays extortion.

Anneke cannot play Extortion.
Extortion can only be played after combat.
Also, after Shilmulo Deception, Anneke cannot play Extortion anyhow,
since she is not the blocker.

> Petru plays Illusions of the
> Kindred, and then Extortion.

OK.

> The New vampire is another Petru. When
> combat from this Petru ends, Petru wishes to play Extortion.

Can't. Petru's already played one.
Unless you're talking about the Illusion.
The Illusion cannot play it either, for two reasons:
1) He's not the blocking minion.
2) After combat, he's not in the game. Vampires not in the game cannot
play cards.

> What's wrong with the above? Why? Especially that last bit. "...this
> vampire [petru: we can't tell the difference between this petru and
> the previous one, can we?]

Of course we can.

> has succesfully blocked." so why are you
> going to say "no"?

Because we can tell them apart (otherwise, how would we know which one
to remove from the game?), and, overriding any other argument, he's
not in the game.

> 2.) Jason is acting. He's blocked by Anneke. Same thing as above
> happens. Who burns blood? Anneke, Petru number one, or Petru number
> two (obviously the latter is moot if that second Petru isn't
> considered blocking).

Petru #1.

> 3.) That first bits moot because the Illusionary Petru gets removed
> from the game before he could play a card that says "play after
> combat, if any", isn't it? Sorry...

Right.

> 4.) Is an IotK vampire from a succesful blocking vampire considered
> blocking?

No.
